title: Tasker plugin vanished
symptom: After updating to version 2021.08.02, the Tasker plugin no longer registers with Tasker. Tasker fires a 'Missing Plugin' notification when a task calls xDrip+, and the task does not fire. Reverting to 2021.07.31 restores the plugin.
cause: The issue was caused by package renaming changes that affected the Tasker plugin's registration with Tasker.
fix: The fix was to exclude Tasker from package renaming, which was done in version 2021.08.02c. The user confirmed that this version resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Issue is solved by excluding Tasker from package renaming.
